It ties the shown form to the go1.26.6 backport #80619 and links CL 858581, and no comment says the bug is fixed. go.dev/doc/devel/release gives go1.26.6 on 2026-08-13, go1.26.10 and go1.27.3 on 2026-10-19, and go1.26.11 and go1.27.4 on 2026-11-10 with unnamed compiler fixes. web3_clientVersion on 2026-11-25 returned Geth/v1.8.2-4e1c8247-20261104/linux-amd64/go1.26.10 from bsc-dataseed1, avalanchego/1.15.3 with go=1.26.10 from api.avax.network, bor/a863b8e5cce1/v2.11.1-private/linux-amd64/go1.26.10 from polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com on the second try (the first hit a Cloudflare challenge), and from forno.celo.org one batched call of six answered Geth/v0.1.0-untagged-c7ed55b8-20260817/linux-amd64/go1.24.13 and five answered reth/v2.2.0-74cc8bb. The bor v2.11.1 Dockerfile starts FROM golang:1.26.10-alpine, the bor and avalanchego v1.15.3 go.mod files say go 1.26.10, the bsc v1.8.2 Dockerfile uses golang:1.26-alpine, and celo op-geth c7ed55b8 uses golang:1.24-alpine3.22. The work files show 0 mismatches and 0 errors for all 99,985 battery vectors and all 85,544 targeted vectors on the four endpoints. offsets.py passed 200 of 200 vectors on 137, 56 and 43114, and 200 of 200 on Celo pinned to op-geth. On the mixed Celo endpoint, 35 rdcopy8 vectors show a reth OutOfOffset error string where FAIL is expected. verdicts.factCheck: The celo-org/reth 74cc8bb cached_state.rs was fetched. insert_state begins at line 832, and lines 863-881 remove a destroyed account whose original info has no code without touching its storage. The okx/reth 81573d2 and bnb-chain/reth 3b2bd02 copies are 1325 and 1284 lines long and hold the same function. block_access_list returns None in celo-org/optimism b08a8d0 payload.rs lines 74-76, in okx/optimism main payload.rs lines 69-71 and in reth-bsc v0.1.4-hotfix validator.rs lines 325-327. Lines 801-804 of the celo prewarm.rs read storage_changes and storage_reads from the access list. A seeding path the finding does not name was also checked. The non-BAL prewarm inserts storage into the cache on a miss (cached_state.rs line 469 onward, PREWARM branch). It executes against the parent state, where an address that is codeless at the start of the block has no code, so no frame can SLOAD it. The destroyed-codeless case needs a create and a destroy in one transaction. Creation is refused at an address with nonzero storage (EIP-7610) or a nonzero nonce, and an EIP-7702 delegated account has code in its original info and takes the clear-all branch. No stale word can be seeded.

clearedSpotChecks.check: L-808, RUSTSEC-2025-0137: every caller of reciprocal_mg10 in ruint 1.15.0 and 1.16.0 normalises the divisor on the DIV, MOD, SDIV, SMOD, ADDMOD and MULMOD paths (HyperEVM 999).
clearedSpotChecks.note: RUSTSEC-2025-0137 (rustsec.org) concerns reciprocal_mg10 relying on debug_assert in releases before 1.17.0. In ruint-1.16.0 from static.crates.io, div_inlined (algorithms/div/mod.rs lines 56-107) trims zero limbs from both operands and sends a one-limb pair to div_1x1. Otherwise it calls div_nx1, div_nx2 with a nonzero high limb, or div_nxm. div_nx1 shifts by leading_zeros before reciprocal (small.rs lines 69-75). div_nxm normalises the top double word before reciprocal_2 (knuth.rs lines 105-120). No unnormalised divisor reaches the reciprocal. The 1.15.0 crate was not re-read.
